summary: Full regression + workflow validation after Milestone 13 (Decision Flow Alignment). Backend: 76 passed + 1 pre-existing skip across 6 procurement/orders test files — ZERO regressions. Frontend: all 10 review items PASS with ONE minor cosmetic flag (word 'executed' appears in info bar copy 'no purchase is executed' inside panel-decisions; the forbidden-words check is intended for action verbs Accept/Approve/Execute on buttons/cards — the info bar explicitly uses 'executed' to inform users nothing is executed, which is the opposite of the forbidden semantic; reviewer discretion).

Semantically CORRECT (explicitly telling users nothing is executed) but the word technically matches the 'Execute' forbidden-word substring. Consider rewording to e.g. 'no purchase is placed' to satisfy a strict string scan. NON-BLOCKING cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: ProcurementCommandCenterPage.js — centerDecisions predicate chain (type in {switch_vendor, renegotiate} AND decision_confidence>=0.80 AND observation_count>=3, capped at 7) is correct. Verified live: 2 cards, both within gate.

ProcurementCommandCenterPage.js — Triage panel tabs correctly reduced from the legacy 4-tab (Saved/To review/Low Conf/Missing Data/Needs Review) to the 3-tab mutually-exclusive classification (missing_data > low_confidence > needs_review). Legacy testids right-tab-saved / right-tab-review confirmed absent. No right-acted-btn-* or right-ignore-btn-* on /procurement — correctly moved to /procurement/history only.

ProcurementCommandCenterPage.js — decision card buttons renamed to spec labels: 'Save Insight' + 'Review Later' (testids decision-save-insight-* + decision-review-later-*). No 'Accept' / 'Approve' text in card body.

PurchaseSuggestionModal.js — acknowledgment checkbox gating confirm button works correctly; confirm is disabled until checkbox is checked. POST /api/procurement/suggestions returns 200 with canonical_product_id + recommendation payload. Modal itself contains 'ADVISORY ONLY' badge and language 'does not place orders, submit anything to vendors, or send any communication' — good safety copy.

ProcurementInboxPage.js — Title correctly reads 'Saved History' (not 'Saved Suggestions Inbox'); history-breadcrumb is a proper Link back to /procurement. Three tabs saved_for_review / acted_on / not_pursued functional with correct counts (22/16/19 on demo tenant).

OrdersPage.js — preseedItemIds seeds lines with quantity_ordered: 0 and no vendor; hint pills load asynchronously; clicking hint-suggested-qty-* pill correctly fills the line-qty input (one-click, never auto-applied on render). hint-better-price-* correctly appears conditionally (only when ≥2% cheaper alternate vendor exists).

OrdersPage.js — 'Better price available? View Procurement →' banner link (orders-procurement-link → /procurement) is prominent. No forbidden phrases (auto-order / apply recommendation / Create PO) anywhere.
App.js — 8 legacy procurement routes all consolidated to <Navigate to='/procurement?panel=<name>' replace/> with intent-preserving query string. /expenses → /expenses/raw-materials redirect works.

Minor: Info bar copy in panel-decisions contains the word 'executed' (in the phrase 'no purchase is executed') which technically overlaps with the Accept/Approve/Execute forbidden-word family semantically used for call-to-action verbs. Non-blocking.
No backend file changes required this iteration — full regression test suite is green.

context_for_next_testing_agent: export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) before pytest. The PurchaseSuggestionModal uses a shadcn Checkbox (role=checkbox on a <button>, NOT an <input type=checkbox>) — use [role=dialog] [role=checkbox] selector. Save Insight confirm button is labeled 'Save Suggestion' (not 'Save Insight') inside the modal — that is intentional (the card-level button says 'Save Insight' for user-facing action, modal button says 'Save Suggestion' for persistence action). Demo tenant counts (as of this iter end): ~23 saved_for_review, 16 acted_on, 19 not_pursued, 2 high-confidence decision cards. The word 'executed' in the panel-decisions info bar is the only forbidden-word substring match and is semantically intentional ('no purchase is executed') — consider as copy-edit, not defect.
